description: Delete one coupon from an app. WRITE, human-gated: a real delete requires an elicitation-capable client; the human sees the exact coupon (code, percent, redemption count) and must click approve. The model cannot confirm on its own, and confirm_used is only consulted for dry_run previews. Clients without elicitation are refused (dry_run still works anywhere). Removes the Stripe coupon object and then the `coupons` row, exactly like the dashboard's delete, so no orphaned Stripe object is left behind. Deleting is permanent and the code becomes reusable afterwards. Set dry_run:true to see exactly which coupon would go (and its redemption count) without touching anything. Use list_coupons first to confirm the code.
name: delete_coupon
